meta.name: timeline-report
meta.description: Generate a "Journey Into [Project]" narrative report analyzing a project's entire development history from claude-mem's timeline. Use when asked for a timeline report, project history analysis, development journey, or full project report.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 生成项目开发历程的叙事报告
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从开发时间线生成项目回顾报告
copy.tagline_en: Generate a narrative report of a project's development history
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to generate a project retrospective from development timeline

howto.what: 装上后，当用户要求生成项目时间线报告时，Claude 会从 claude-mem 拉取该项目完整开发历史，估算 token 成本，征得确认后部署子代理分析，产出并保存《Journey Into [项目名]》叙事报告（markdown 文件）。
howto.when: 当用户提到“时间线报告”“项目历史分析”“Journey into [项目]”等请求，或要求完整的项目开发报告时触发。前提是 claude-mem worker 在运行且项目已有记忆记录。

say.text: 写一份这个项目的时间线报告。
say.note: 会基于当前目录项目生成报告。

say.text: 为我的 tokyo 项目写一篇 Journey Into 叙事报告。
say.note: 会生成 Journey Into tokyo 报告。

say.text: 总结整个项目的开发历史，生成完整报告。
say.note: 会触发完整流程并保存为 markdown。

howto.what_en: When asked for a project timeline report, Claude pulls the full history from claude-mem, estimates token cost, asks for confirmation, has a subagent analyze it, then saves a 'Journey Into [Project]' narrative report as markdown.
howto.when_en: Triggers when asked for a timeline report, project history, 'Journey into [project]', or a full project report. Requires the claude-mem worker running and recorded observations for the project.

say_en.text: Write a timeline report for this project.
Write a Journey Into report for my tokyo project.
say_en.note: Generates a Journey Into tokyo report.

say_en.text: Summarize the full development history into a complete report.
say_en.note: Runs the full flow and saves a markdown file.
